title: Impact Of Bacterial Resistance On Healthcare Costs For Hospitalized Patients With Complicated Intra-Abdominal Infections
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to estimate the costs of empiric antibiotic therapy and hospitalization costs for patients with a complicated intra-abdominal infection, and to assess the impact of treatment failure of initial antibiotic empiric therapy on pharmacological and total healthcare costs for these patients in Greece.
study_population: Patients hospitalized for complicated intra-abdominal infections
